tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published tools on Awesome Tools. query matches name, tagline, and description. category and tag take slugs from list_categories and list_tags. limit defaults to 20 (max 50).

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get a tool by slug. Published tools return public details. Unpublished submissions return their status, eligibility, and free/paid next steps.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories with published tool counts. Use the slugs in submit_tool.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags with published tool counts.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Submit your own SaaS or AI tool. plan free_backlink is free for sites with domain rating 20+, saves the listing, and needs a visible badge link on your site (returns the badge HTML; then call verify_my_backlink). plan featured_49 ($49 Featured Launch, no backlink needed) or sponsor_149 ($149 Feature

tools.name: verify_my_backlink
tools.description: Check the Awesome Tools badge or link on your site for an unpublished free listing. backlinkUrl defaults to the listing's website. When the link is live and the site is eligible, the listing is scheduled and the submitter is emailed.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback to the Awesome Tools team, optionally about a tool slug.
